card_text: Mixers and grinders repaired at the shop.
title: Mixer and grinder repair in Bhaktapur
intro: We repair mixers and grinders in-house at our shop in Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur. Bring it to the shop and we'll check it.
how: Bring the appliance to the shop in Sukuldhoka.
We check it and tell you the price before any work starts.
ask: Hi, mixer/grinder repair bare sodhnu chha.
